# Recommendica

> AI research paper recommendations and grounded search over peer-reviewed literature, with citations and faithfulness scores.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/
- API: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/api/
- API Catalog: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://recommendica.nevatal.id/auth.md
